meta.title: Browser tuner
meta.description: A calm, private browser tuner for guitar and bass.

tuner.heading: Tuner
tuner.intro: A focused tuning space for every practice session.

chromatic.supportedRange: Chromatic Reference Tones support C1 through B7.

status.listenReady: Start tuning when your instrument is ready.
status.ready: Choose a String and hear its Target Pitch.
status.readyChromatic: Choose a note and octave, then hear the Target Pitch.
status.playing: {{noteName}} keeps playing until you stop it.
status.error: The Reference Tone could not start. Check browser audio and try again.

microphone.permission-denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in browser settings, then try again, or use Reference Tone.
microphone.microphone-unavailable: No microphone is available. Connect or enable one, then try again, or use Reference Tone.
microphone.microphone-unsupported: This browser cannot use the microphone here. Try a supported browser or use Reference Tone.
microphone.microphone-unreadable: The microphone could not start. Close other apps using it, then try again, or use Reference Tone.

tuner.privacy: Audio is processed on this device. It is not recorded or uploaded.
